content: No... I won't. If you have something to tell her, tell her yourself.

content: She's... She's a clever girl, and still so young. A nice girl. If she finds a good man in the frontier, she should let herself fall in love again.

content: I want her to be happy... God... why'd I have to treat her like that? If I'd known Carl was going to...

speaker: Leone
content: No... Forget what I said. Tell her... Tell her I'm glad she still remembers and loves Carl...

content: But he's gone... He's not here anymore...

speaker: Leone
content: The living... deserve a choice...

speaker: Leone
content: The living... shouldn't be bogged down by the dead...

content: And Benny! He just started school. He's got a bright future ahead of him. Don't you want to see what kind of man he'll become? Don't you want to see your son again?!

content: ♪And from that moment on, I found my dreams in her embrace♪

speaker: Jessica
content: Leone...
